name: Sludge Fen
summary: In northeastern the Barrens, Sludge Fen's clear pool has become an oily industrial field run by the Venture Company. Supervisor Lugwizzle oversees the drilling, while rivals in Ratchet seek to sabotage the operation.

sections.title: Industrial Devastation
sections.body: Sludge Fen once held a clear pool fed by natural springs in the arid Barrens. The Venture Company built oil-drilling platforms and machinery over the basin, turning the wetland into a reservoir of sludge and industrial waste. Supervisor Lugwizzle oversees goblin drillers, engineers, and overseers as they pump crude oil around the clock. Runoff and toxic byproducts coat the water, choking the native aquatic life beneath the grease.

sections.title: Corporate Rivalry and Espionage
sections.body: Sludge Fen's machinery and shredder designs have drawn industrial thieves. In nearby Ratchet, Tinkers' Union engineer Sputtervalve faced pressure to match the Venture Company's logging and excavation technology. Instead of making his own designs, Sputtervalve sent Wizzlecrank to seize a Venture Company shredder from the fen. Wizzlecrank took the machine without its ignition key, leaving it stranded. Mercenaries are often drawn into the mire to pry the keys from Lugwizzle and escort the shredder through furious Venture Co. employees.

faq.q: What was Sludge Fen like before the Venture Company arrived?
faq.answer: Before the Venture Company arrived, Sludge Fen was a crystal-clear pool fed by natural springs. The company's oil rig and refining operation covered the basin in crude oil and chemical refuse.

faq.q: Who runs the operation at Sludge Fen?
faq.answer: Supervisor Lugwizzle runs the oil field for the Venture Company. He oversees the drillers, engineers, and overseers, with lieutenants including Overseer Glibby and Foreman Grills.

faq.q: Why is there a hijacked shredder parked in the middle of the fen?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve sent Wizzlecrank from Ratchet to steal the Venture Company's shredder design. Wizzlecrank entered the cockpit without the ignition key and became stranded among hostile Venture Co. workers.

faq.q: Why do druids dive into these polluted waters?
faq.answer: Horde druids on the Trial of the Sea Lion dive to the bottom of the contaminated pool to retrieve the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility from a submerged lockbox. The foul water tests their endurance.

angles.text: As a Horde druid, you enter Sludge Fen's oily depths during the Trial of the Sea Lion to retrieve the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility.
The Venture Company operates advanced shredders and machinery at Sludge Fen. Blueprints, specialized components, and trade theft orchestrated from Ratchet draw interest to the site.
